Date: 2026-07-19
Home movement session, evening, about 55 min total. Focus was skills + core.

Warmed up with wrist circles and some cat-cow, maybe 3 min, then 2 min easy skipping.

Juggling 3-ball cascade — did 4 runs, counts were 22, 31, 38, 29 catches. The 38 run
felt smooth, drops mostly from throwing too far forward.

Reaction drill on the phone app, 3 blocks of 20 taps. avg 245ms best 198ms on the
last block, first block was sluggish avg 290ms.

L-sit on parallettes: 5 holds — 18s, 16s, 15s, 12s, 10s. Tuck was clean on first
three, legs dropping after that. RPE like 8 on the last one.

Shadow boxing 3 rounds x 3 min, easy pace round 1, pushed rounds 2 and 3.

Ab straps hanging knee raises 3 x 12, slow and controlled, no swing.

KB swings with the 20kg — 3 sets of 15, felt crisp.

Cooldown: couch stretch 60s each side, hamstring stretch 90s.
